findings.summary: Grounding fields can leak raw values and rationale text into events and exports: off-mode citations and an on-mode answer's unexpected rationale remain ordinary arguments, persisted before verification and exported.
Grounding schema construction breaks otherwise valid tools even when grounding is off: a tool with an answer argument named citations or a write argument named rationale cannot initialize.
The on-to-off pinning test checks no driver call after the flip.
